line: Leave a kind note where a stranger will find it.
paragraph: A little dog named Luna, a Jack Russell terrier, ten years old, slipped out of a locked cabin in Yellowstone one September day. She had come from California with her owners, who taped a sign to the door asking people not to open it. For more than a month she roamed the park alone, through cold nights and pine forests. Park workers and visitors kept watch, and someone finally spotted her. Her owners drove back from California to collect her. A woman found Luna limping near a geyser basin and coaxed her into the car. The dog slept all the way to the reunion.
